Can be purchased with [Culture] [in all cities]
Can be purchased with [Faith] [in all cities]
Cost increases by [5] when built
Remove [Marble Stoneworks] [in this city]

civilopediaText.text: RESOURCE SUPPLY / LUXURY / REPEATABLE

Constructing Marble Stoneworks adds another +100 Marble to your empire-wide available supply for 999,999 turns. Every construction stacks. The building then removes itself so you can immediately construct it again.
Also grants a continuing +2 Gold benefit in your capital per construction. This preserves the original facility's small extra yield as an accumulating national benefit.
This creates resource supply, not a map deposit or 100 copies added to a stockpile each turn.
Resource facilities are grouped by their colored icons and RESOURCE SUPPLY descriptions within the normal Buildings section. JSON mods cannot add a new construction tab.
